variables.label: Suffix
variables.description: Fixed sentence text after the rolling word slot.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds (from mount start) for each word swap. Empty keeps the authored even spread.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used by the rolling word slot.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: Optional departure. Default none: the sentence holds until the frame cuts.

official.tweak_notes: word-roll kinetic type reads energetic/playful; usable sparingly for a stat callout with slower timing

official.name: spring-pop
official.title: Spring Pop
official.description: A badge pops in from a visible near-rest scale, overshoots full size once, and settles cleanly.

variables.label: Overshoot
variables.description: Strength passed to the back.out entrance curve.

variables.label: Starting scale
variables.description: Scale at the start of the entrance.

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Text displayed inside the badge.

official.tweak_notes: overshoot pop is generic UI-badge motion; usable for a small stat badge but bouncy tone risks feeling too playful

official.name: beat-freeze-cut
official.title: Beat Freeze Cut
official.description: A beat-driven speed ramp, freeze-frame hit, and hard-cut sequence for music-led promos and montages.
official.tweak_notes: strip music-video energy, slow the ramp for a dramatic archival beat; no visuals available, judged from text

official.name: card-resize
official.title: Card Resize
official.description: A transitions.dev-inspired card resize primitive that expands a compact card into a detail panel

variables.label: Surface
variables.description: Card colour scheme: paper is the original white card, ink is a dark card for dark frames.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Treatment of the media thumbnail: a plain plate, a hatched surface, or an image plate with a horizon-and-disc glyph.

variables.label: Elevation
variables.description: How far the card lifts off the frame, from a contact shadow to a deep drop.

official.tweak_notes: card expand could work for a document/detail reveal but likely too UI-app flavored

official.name: page-slide
official.title: Page Slide
official.description: A transitions.dev-inspired page slide primitive with outgoing and incoming panels

variables.label: Outgoing label
variables.description: Label printed on the page that slides out.

variables.label: Incoming label
variables.description: Label printed on the page that slides in.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Gradient family painted on the incoming page. The outgoing page stays slate.

variables.label: Corner
variables.description: Corner radius of the frame the pages slide inside.

official.tweak_notes: generic panel slide, plausible for bulletin/document beat but plain

official.name: panel-reveal
official.title: Panel Reveal
official.description: A panel reveal primitive with height expansion and content fade

variables.label: Title
variables.description: The header line that sits above the folded body.

variables.label: Width
variables.description: How wide the panel sits, 280, 360 or 480 px.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Surface family: paper is the white card for light frames, ink inverts it for dark frames.

variables.label: Reveal
variables.description: Whether the body fades in with the height. fade is the shipped motion, solid opens the height only.

official.tweak_notes: height-expand content fade is generic UI panel, situational for stat card reveal

official.name: rubber-band-bumper
official.title: Rubber Band Bumper
official.description: An outgoing panel pulls against increasing resistance, holds at tension, then snaps past an edge with overshoot as the incoming panel settles behind it.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Edge the outgoing panel releases through.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color applied to the tension bands and incoming panel.

official.tweak_notes: overshoot/snap panel transition is a bit bouncy/playful for the tone, situational

official.name: transitions-3d
official.title: 3D Transitions
official.description: Showcase of 3D perspective flip and rotate transitions
official.tweak_notes: 3D flip/rotate reads flashy/SaaS-promo, off-tone unless heavily muted

official.name: transitions-cover

official.name: transitions-grid

official.name: transitions-other

official.name: transitions-push
official.title: Push Transitions
official.description: Showcase of push and slide transitions
official.tweak_notes: push/slide reads corporate-deck, weak tonal fit

official.name: transitions-scale
official.title: Scale Transitions
official.description: Showcase of scale and zoom transitions
official.tweak_notes: scale/zoom showcase reads generic/promo, weak fit

official.name: apple-money-count
official.title: Apple Money Count
official.description: Apple-style finance counter that counts from $0 to $10,000, flashes green, and bursts money icons with sound.
official.tweak_notes: drop money icon burst + sfx + green flash; keep the count-up mechanic, reskin to Courier/crimson stat card

official.name: caption-blend-difference
official.title: Blend Difference
official.description: Auto-inverting text using mix-blend-mode: difference — flips between white and black per-pixel against the background
official.tweak_notes: auto-inverting difference blend is a gimmicky effect, unlikely fit for serious captions unless used very subtly

official.name: perspective-marquee
official.title: Perspective Marquee
official.description: A 3D tilted marquee with depth feel as items roll toward the horizon.

variables.label: Tilt
variables.description: How far the marquee plane leans back toward the horizon.

variables.label: Travel
variables.description: Scales the offset the timeline drives, so the strip covers a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Pill colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides the brand token.

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Comma separated pill labels. The list is laid down twice so the strip still reads as a continuous loop.

official.tweak_notes: 3D rolling pill marquee is too playful/product-y for a documentary; not a natural doc beat

official.name: text-stagger
official.title: Text Stagger
official.description: A transitions.dev-inspired text stagger primitive with enter, shimmer, and exit-ready words

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Headline copy. Every whitespace-separated word becomes one staggered span.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size of every word in pixels, clamped to 24-160. Line height stays proportional.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Base word colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the shimmer the second timeline step sweeps across the words.

official.tweak_notes: built-in shimmer sweep across words reads too polished/promo for the channel's grit

official.name: ticker-takeover
official.title: Ticker Takeover
official.description: A mono ticker rolls through options, locks on a final word with an accent flash, and promotes it into a full-frame headline.

variables.label: Options
variables.description: Comma-separated words shown by the ticker.

variables.label: Final word
variables.description: Word the ticker locks on and promotes.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Color used for the lock flash and promoted word.

official.tweak_notes: slot-machine word-lock-then-promote feels like a hype/reveal gimmick, not documentary tone unless heavily slowed

official.name: top-down-letters
official.title: Top-Down Letters
official.description: Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase with zero blur.

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word that cascades in. Every character becomes one letter span, in source order.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: Multiplies the drop the timeline drives, so the letters cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Letter colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.

official.tweak_notes: pronounced staircase drop is a bit playful/kinetic for the somber tone, situational at best

official.name: type-match-cut
official.title: Type Match Cut
official.description: A headline splits vertically around an incoming panel, which grows from the negative space and takes the frame as the words exit through opposite edges.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Text split around the incoming panel.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Accent color used by the incoming editor scene.

official.storm_use: chapter transition (headline splits to reveal next scene)
official.tweak_notes: structurally could work as a scene transition but is styled/labeled like a product feature reveal

official.name: wordmark-tiles
official.title: Wordmark Tiles
official.description: A wordmark resolves from deterministic color noise into correctly cropped glyph tiles through a spatially modulated GSAP wave.

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Text resolved by the tile wave.

variables.label: Columns
variables.description: Number of columns in the wordmark tile grid.

variables.label: Wave stagger
variables.description: Delay between tile reveals in spatial wave order.

official.tweak_notes: noisy tile-resolve reveal reads as a flashy product-launch wordmark effect, tonally off

official.name: yt-prism-title
official.title: Chromatic Fringe Title
official.description: Display title on a transparent root: blur-focus entrance, red/blue fringe that settles then breathes, perspective bow, slow scale drift
official.tweak_notes: chromatic fringe RGB-split feels glitchy/social-creator; too flashy unless fringe heavily reduced
